title: WorldK consumer contracts v1 — common definitions
description: Shared primitives for the WorldK consumption contracts (M07). Owner: AvatarK Platform. Contains no runtime/kernel/compiler types.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version MAJOR.MINOR. Consumers accept any 1.x; a MAJOR bump is a breaking change and a new contract.

semanticId.description: Stable, opaque, kebab-case identifier. Identity only, never display copy. Never reused for a different entity.

opaqueId.description: Producer-minted opaque identifier (event/change/activity ids). Consumers must not parse it.

slug.description: URL/display slug. May change over time (with redirects); never used as identity.

subjectId.description: AvatarK IdentityClaims.subjectId (backed by Supabase auth.users.id in the platform project). PRIVATE.

worldTick.description: Authoritative logical world time (platform WorldClock tick). Machine-only: WorldK MUST NOT display it as consumer copy.

worldTime.description: A point in world time: authoritative tick underneath + producer-supplied consumer-safe label.

worldSignificance.description: WORLD significance, decided by World Memory's significance filter (MemorySignificance minus NOT_SIGNIFICANT, which is never projected). World truth — identical for every viewer.

freshness.description: Producer-declared freshness. WorldK never infers freshness beyond one mechanical rule: a CURRENT payload read after staleAfter MUST be rendered as STALE.

validAsOf.description: Wall-clock instant the underlying authoritative state represents.

sourceRevision.description: Opaque producer revision (e.g. world artifact digest / projection build). Consumers compare for equality only.

reason.description: Why the state is not CURRENT. Null when CURRENT.
